Name: Erossavia's Ranch
Author: Erossavia
Description:
Welcome to the ranch! This is a 120x75 map that replaces the Foraging Farm map.  It offers 7 preexisting animal pens on the right side of the map and 4 on the left with one end open so you can close it off and include a gate for easy access. Ample room for farming, sheds, silos, windmills, or slimehutches as well.

Known issue: The warp point between town and the bus stop works perfectly. Coming from the bus stop back into the ranch, however, causes a problem if you are mounted on the horse or tractor. The horse/tractor gets stuck on the way back onto the farm and I cannot figure out what is causing it. However, if you dismount and walk through it works perfectly. The other two warp points (backwoods and toward Marnie's) works fine whether mounted or not.

 To install simply unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.
